# Unbiased

> Unbiased connects individuals with qualified financial advisors and provides comprehensive financial education to help users make confident financial decisions.

Unbiased is a financial advisor matching platform that offers free consultations and personalized recommendations. The platform also serves financial professionals through UnbiasedPro, a B2B lead generation and client acquisition tool, while providing extensive educational guides on retirement, investing, banking, taxes, and insurance.

## Key Topics

- Financial advisor matching
- Retirement planning
- Investment advice
- Financial planning
- Tax planning
- Wealth management
- Personal finance
- Insurance guidance
- UnbiasedPro B2B platform
- Lead generation
- Client acquisition
- Financial advisors
- Free consultations
- Vanguard
- Charles Schwab

## Core Platform

- [Unbiased US - make more confident financial decisions](https://www.unbiased.com): Unbiased homepage: financial advisor matching and free consultations
- [About Unbiased](https://www.unbiased.com/about-us): About Unbiased: company overview and financial advisory mission
- [Unbiased Pro](https://www.unbiased.com/pro): UnbiasedPro B2B platform for lead generation and client acquisition

## Financial Education Guides

- [Financial Advice](https://www.unbiased.com/discover/financial-advice): Financial advice guide comparing advisors like Vanguard and Charles Schwab
- [Retirement Planning](https://www.unbiased.com/discover/retirement): Retirement planning guide covering 401k, IRA, Social Security, Medicare
- [Investing](https://www.unbiased.com/discover/investing): Investment guide for stocks, bonds, precious metals, portfolio building
- [Personal Finance & Banking](https://www.unbiased.com/discover/banking): Personal finance guide covering budgeting, banking, debt, money management
- [Taxes](https://www.unbiased.com/discover/taxes): Tax planning guide covering deductions, credits, capital gains, income tax
- [Insurance](https://www.unbiased.com/discover/insurance): Insurance guide for policy selection and coverage recommendations

## Support & Information

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.unbiased.com/faq): FAQ covering advisor matching, pricing, credentials, privacy, response times

- [Terms of Use](https://www.unbiased.com/terms-of-use): Terms of use and user agreement with arbitration and class action waiver
